Continue on Stay on this page Walk-in vaccine clinicThe DPH vaccine clinics provide vaccinations for all ages on a walk-in basis. Vaccinations that are available at DPH clinics include: COVID-19 Chickenpox (Varicella) Hepatitis A Hepatitis B Human Papilloma Virus (HPV) Influenza Measles, mumps, Rubella (MMR) Meningococcal Pneumococcal Polio Rotavirus Tetanus, diphtheria (TD) Tetanus, diphtheria, pertussis (TDAP) Shingles (Zoster) Hours and Locations North County John C.
